messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Warning message but OK-results
parts:
vcov(Model3_medi) is the sampling covariance matrix of the estimated parameters.  The warning suggests that there is some redundancy among your parameters, which might (hence, only a warning) mean the model is not identified.  This is not an uncommon occurrence in bifactor models, EFA models, multitrait-multimethod (MTMM) models, or any other model whose lambda is rank-deficient.  As you said, the results appear fine, so it looks like you can ignore the warning. 

Terrence D. Jorgensen
Assistant Professor, Methods and Statistics
